title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Binary Equality Test
statement: For a bit string $z$, parse its two components, using the empty string for either component when parsing fails. The function that outputs the single bit $1$ exactly when the two components have equal lengths and represent equal natural numbers in least-significant-bit-first binary, and outputs $0$ otherwise, is computable in polynomial time by a finite Turing machine.
